title: First of Many
description: You put your fate in the hands of a small plastic solid. It begins.
reward: A lifelong and entirely justified suspicion of twenty-sided objects.

title: Statistically Inevitable
description: The die came up twenty. You will bring this up for years.
reward: One (1) anecdote, to be retold at increasing volume.

title: Statistically Also Inevitable
description: The die came up one. Nobody blames you. Everybody blames you.
reward: +1 Sympathy. Non-transferable, non-refundable.

title: Demonstrably Less Terrible
description: You survived enough poor decisions to get measurably better at them.
reward: A larger pool of hit points to lose dramatically.

title: Briefly Horizontal
description: You reached zero hit points and learned this flagstone's opinion of you.
reward: An intimate familiarity with the floor.

title: Alarmingly Experienced
description: Level five. You are now the dangerous kind of confident.
reward: The right to say 'in my experience' without being laughed at. Mostly.

title: The Door Tax
description: A door was closed. It is no longer closed. It is no longer a door.
reward: +2 Property Damage. The dungeon is keeping receipts.

title: Torch Economics
description: You did the maths on your light source and did not enjoy the answer.
reward: A creeping awareness of how dark dark actually is.

title: Asked The Obvious Question
description: You asked the thing everyone was thinking. It did not help.
reward: Clarity. Unwanted, unhelpful clarity.

title: You Poked It
description: It was sitting there, minding its business. You had a stick and a theory.
reward: Empirical data, acquired the hard way.

title: Load-Bearing Pockets
description: You took something that was not nailed down, then tested the nails.
reward: Encumbrance, spiritual and literal.

title: Improvised Solution
description: That was not what the object was for. It worked anyway.
reward: The dungeon quietly updates its threat assessment of you.

title: Words, Somehow
description: Something enormous wanted to eat you. You talked it out of it.
reward: +2 Silver Tongue. Terms and conditions apply.

title: Counted The Exits
description: You checked how to leave before deciding to stay. Suspicious competence.
reward: A survival instinct. Do try to keep hold of it.

title: Cursed, And Keeping It
description: It is clearly cursed. It is clearly yours. Both facts are load-bearing.
reward: The item. Obviously. That's rather the problem.

title: Read It Aloud
description: There was writing. You said it out loud. In a dungeon. On purpose.
reward: Whatever happens next. That's the reward. That's what you get.

title: The Trap Found You First
description: You were looking for traps. One of them was looking for you. It won.
reward: A new appreciation for pressure plates.

title: Made A Friend, Regrettably
description: Something in here likes you now. Nobody is comfortable with this.
reward: An ally with unclear motives and worse hygiene.

title: You Named It
description: You gave something a name. Now you can't leave it behind. Well done.
reward: Emotional attachment, weaponised against you.

title: The Plan Survived Contact
description: You had a plan. It worked. Neither of us saw that coming.
reward: Unearned confidence, freshly minted.

title: A Dreadful Plan, Beautifully Executed
description: It should not have worked. It worked. I am filing a complaint.
reward: +3 Audacity. The universe is watching you now.

title: Carried Somebody Out
description: Someone couldn't walk. You made that your problem instead of theirs.
reward: The good kind of reputation. Rare, down here.

title: Walked Away From It
description: You could have. You didn't. Restraint, in a dungeon. Extraordinary.
reward: Everything you still have, on account of not touching that.

title: Gave It Back
description: It was valuable. It wasn't yours. You made the boring, correct choice.
reward: A clear conscience, which weighs nothing and buys less.

title: Held The Line
description: You were losing and you stayed anyway. That's the whole achievement.
reward: Scars with a decent story attached.

title: Solved It Sideways
description: There was a puzzle. You refused to engage with it on its own terms.
reward: The puzzle's grudging respect, and its resignation.

title: Last One Standing
description: Everyone else was down. You were not. This was not the plan.
reward: Sole responsibility. Enjoy that.

title: Out Of Absolutely Everything
description: No supplies, no light, no plan. Still moving. Somehow still moving.
reward: Grit. It's not a stat. It should be.

title: Kept A Promise
description: You said you would. Then, unusually, you did.
reward: One NPC updates their opinion of you. Permanently.

title: Magnificent Catastrophe
description: Not merely a failure. A failure with scope. A failure with ambition.
reward: A story. An expensive, irreversible, genuinely excellent story.

title: Outsmarted The Room
description: The dungeon had a plan for you. You had a better one. Rude.
reward: The architecture takes this personally now.

title: Should Have Died There
description: By any reasonable accounting that killed you. You've been let off.
reward: Borrowed time. The interest is dreadful.

title: Changed The Story
description: This campaign will not go the way it was going. Because of you.
reward: Consequences with your name written on them.

title: Broke The Narrator
description: I had something prepared. I'm not going to be able to use it now.
reward: My genuine, unwilling admiration. Don't get used to it.

title: Nobody Died
description: Everyone walked out. Everyone. I checked twice.
reward: A quiet drink and the absence of a funeral.
